fusions.name: Eaten to Stubble
fusions.desc: A stripping cut that deals 26 damage, heals you for 30% of the damage dealt and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Hopper Trench
fusions.desc: Digs a 4-tile trench full of hoppers ahead of you for 5 seconds. It deals 7 damage to each enemy that crosses it and leaves it [Sundered] for 6 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Nothing Left to Bury
fusions.desc: Strips every body within 8 tiles, up to 5; each gives back 7% of your health.

fusions.name: Gorged on Gleanings
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 25% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
